title: Box office totals
statementMd:
Report the total `gross_millions` of all movies, and how many movies have **no recorded budget**.

Expected columns: `total_gross`, `missing_budget`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `COUNT(column)` skips NULLs, `COUNT(*)` doesn't. Or use `SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT SUM(gross_millions) AS total_gross, COUNT(*) - COUNT(budget_millions) AS missing_budget FROM movies;
```

Aggregates ignore NULLs, so `COUNT(*) - COUNT(budget_millions)` is the number of NULL budgets.

expected.query: SELECT SUM(gross_millions) AS total_gross, COUNT(*) - COUNT(budget_millions) AS missing_budget FROM movies;
